reviews.text: I took my cat for a bite wound and they were so compassionate, friendly, and try to get my cat to feel better as fast as possible. Would totally recommend and they work with your budget.

I can’t say enough great things about this place! I was in close to midnight last bight with my 12 wk old puppy who accidentally ingested some of her teething toy. The staff was kind, attentive, and very down to earth. I was feeling really anxious before I arrived, but seeing how great the quality was of every patient they were treating made me feel at ease. The environment is very welcoming, and they really make you and your pet feel as comfortable as possible. So happy to report that they were able to retrieve the pieces she swallowed, and she is back to being the playful and sweet girl she is! Thank you so much VEG ER staff. ❤️

Five Stars! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐We recently had to bring our 8-year-old dog, Bella, to VEG in The Heights, and I cannot say enough good things about the care we received. Emergency vet visits are always incredibly stressful, but Dr. Anna Jackson and her amazing tech, Maritza, made a world of difference for us.From the moment we walked into their open-concept hospital, they treated Bella with so much gentleness and compassion. Dr. Jackson was thorough, calm, and took the time to explain everything clearly, while Maritza was incredibly sweet, attentive, and made sure Bella felt safe and comfortable the entire time. They provided exceptional, high-quality care when we needed it most. We are so grateful to Dr. Jackson, Maritza, and the entire VEG Heights team for looking after our sweet girl!

I have been to VEG on several different occasions and always had a great experience, and this time was no different. Everyone was prompt and caring, offered my girl who had just been attacked by another dog a private room so she could be away from the other patients, and answered all my questions.

Wow, amazing emergency vet clinic! I just visited VEG ER for the first time at the recommendation of my regular vet. I am leaving soon for a business trip and couldn’t get in to see my regular vet as quickly as I wanted, so I made a “peace of mind” visit to VEG ER to have my sweet Labrador retriever Jun Jun checked out. Everyone at VEG ER was super nice and super efficient. The front desk staff got me processed and moved to the back to see the doctor within five minutes. I didn’t even have time to complete the online check-in form before Dr. Kail came by. She took her time examining Jun Jun, talked through the possible causes of Jun Jun’s issue with me, provided me with options for what to do (or not do) next, and helped me figure out the best path forward. I could not have asked for a better emergency vet experience. My regular vet’s recommendation to visit VEG ER was spot on.

We came in around 12:30 AM, and I honestly can’t say enough good things about the people here. We were seen almost immediately, and my baby boy was treated with so much care, compassion, and patience.

We had no idea that he had accidentally gotten into some old THC that was left behind. The team walked us through multiple options and made sure we understood what we could do to get our puppy the care he needed.

Everyone was absolutely incredible, especially considering how scared and worried we were. We’re so grateful for the care they gave our little guy. 10/10

I was very worried coming in. When entering I was immediately greeted and taken to an exam table. Right away they assessed. Everything took no longer than 10 mins. They knew immediately what was wrong and we talked options. I left feeling so much better and very reassured. Shalsee Vigeant was very quick to action and also calming. I’m very thankful to her and the staff working tonight.
Took very good care of my dog- very kind, quickly getting to the point without making you feel rushed or overlooked.   Thank you for the care we receive on Saturday evening- All is we!!

I couldn’t be more grateful for the care Ollie received here. Since he was there for over 24 hours, he was cared for by three different doctors as well as multiple assistants and nurses, and every single person was incredibly kind, compassionate, and helpful. They kept me informed, treated Ollie with so much care, and made an incredibly scary experience a little easier for me. I’m so thankful he was in their hands and would highly recommend this team to anyone looking for exceptional veterinary care. ❤️

Brought my cat here after unsuccessfully attempting to obtain life-saving care for him elsewhere. The VEG staff immediately stabilized him and provided us with a clear, correct diagnosis. They took amazing care of my boy during the hardest days of his life. Thanks to their quick thinking and oxygen chamber, my cat is still alive. He 100% would not be here without VEG. I will never be able to fully express how thankful I am for all the wonderful people who work here.
Staff was prompt, compassionate and empathetic

Very Grateful to Dr Finley and the entire team! A neighbor recommended you guys when i was desperate  trying to see a doctor for my baby in pain, from the moment i walked in, receptionist showed real care immediately. They treated my baby with so much care,  you guys are amazing and i cant not be more grateful. Dr finley and her team went above and beyond to make sure i was comfortable but above all my baby pain was taking care immediately, Dr Finley and her team handle everything so professionally from the paperwork to the diagnose and treatment options, communicated with me over the phone even after the visit for a follow up plan with a specialist, she even offered resources for me to help make my baby’s life less painful with his diagnose . Can not thank you enough VEG Houston, Dr Finley and Team for everything you guys did for me and my baby.
They truly care about pets here. Everyone is kind, prompt, and professional. You never want to have to take your pet to ER, but this is the place for it when you have to.

Excellent care, but note VEG ER is private equity-owned (D1 Capital + Fidelity) so expect inflated prices for services, medication, etc. Would recommend choosing an independent practice if your budget is a consideration (search privateequityvet online for a map vet ownership).

I have had 6 Labrador retrievers so I have had plenty (a lot) of vet time. From Parvo to leashes chewed and completely eaten, I have seen it all. vEG is a great choice for emergency care - best I have ever experienced.

I am extremely grateful to veg and all of the staff! They attended to my kitty right away and were extremely kind and reassuring. I can tell the staff here really cares for the animals, and despite the stressful situation, they were very kind, supportive, attentive, and helpful. My kitty is doing better and I'm keeping a close eye on him to make sure it stays that way!

Very attentive staff from check-in, triage, and treatment. I was kept up-to-date every step of the way. While this was an unexpected event that you can’t budget for, they worked with me on a treatment plan I could afford while providing excellent care.

Worst experience ever!!! They had no clue how to help me with my parrot other than to euthanize on the spot unless I paid 1,000's of dollars!! They are all the same they don't care about your pet, they only want the money.
My experience was very good both times I went. They treated my dog ​​with great respect, and I thank them from the bottom of my heart for what they did for my dog. Thank you so much!

Excellent service from all the staff; they are very professional and attentive. In my personal opinion, my dog ​​Luna was treated by Dr. Claudia, who was super attentive and kind. She helped me a lot, and I am very grateful. She is a wonderful person; may God always bless her. 🙏 …

I brought my 14 year old dog here twice- the first time it seemed like she ate something she wasn’t supposed to and was vomiting yellow bile and had wet stool. The second time, she just wouldn’t get up or walk. Both times my pup was cared for right away, with friendly nurses, techs and vets. They keep you updated every step of the way. The first time, I truly believe their care helped extend her life a couple more months, until our most recent visit, where the doctor presented me with options after trying their best to sustain her, and ultimately she helped me decide it was time to cross the rainbow bridge.

They were gracious enough to have me call my loved ones who wanted to see her, they came, and put us in a private room together for her last moments. Even in the room, they brought her a bed, pillows, and blankets to be comfortable. I was able to write her a letter there, give her one last kiss and hug, and said out goodbyes.

I am super grateful for the staff here at VEG. Thank you for making her last day memorable.

I am however taking a star off, because I paid a total of $2k today, which includes her tests and her euthanasia. It is quite jarring to be presented with a total like that the day your baby dies, but I guess that’s capitalism for you.
